objective: On the deterministic clean UNSB baseline, use long-horizon evidence from multiple probe families to discover and reconstruct a new algorithm capable of retaining matched benefit over 200 data epochs.
guarantees: at least one evidence-derived route-1 candidate and one current-best fallback
traceable code, data, configuration, checkpoint and evaluation identities
non_guarantees: positive PSNR or successful reproduction of historical methods
completion of the original 400-epoch UNSB schedule
eligibility for any server work beyond the explicitly authorized host-matched small25 route-1 scope

authorization_required.scope: host-matched small25 route1 anchors, causal audits, and evidence-frozen candidates after per-host preflight

change_policy: Every new algorithm requires an evidence-linked derivation card and frozen protocol before its paired target metrics are read. The two explicitly authorized servers may execute only the host-matched route1 scope in the listed decisions; any broader server use requires a new user decision.
